Five steps, each with a checklist

2026-10-22 · The three steps are now five: Intro (new: the intro every episode opens with, moved out of Series and look onto its own page), Lesson, Clips, Preview and Publish (the old Export, split in two). Under the header, a bar lists what the step asks for, ticked as it is done, with the next item lit, and one button: the next thing to do, or Continue once the step is done. Each page lights one button at a time. Changes are outlined in red.
